title: PRD Tasks
description: Schema for defining tasks in a PRD tasks.yaml file

topLevelTask.description: A top-level task that can optionally contain subtasks

parentTask.description: A task that contains subtasks to be worked in parallel

name.description: A simple summary of the task

description.description: A detailed description of the task

subtasks.description: A list of tasks that can be completed in parallel

plan_after_prior.description: Umbrella levels only: when true, this level's children are not 'ready-to-plan' until every earlier dependency level is fully implemented (all their children completed). Use when a level's plan genuinely can't be written until prior work exists. Read from the top-level (level) entry; ignored on ordinary tasks.

leafTask.description: A task without subtasks that will be completed by a subagent

name.description: A simple summary of the task

description.description: A detailed description of the task

status.description: The current status of the task. 'in-progress' marks work a session started but did not finish, so a later session can resume it.

spec.description: Path to the file that defines the task parameters in detail

plan_after_prior.description: Umbrella levels only: when this leaf is a top-level (level) entry, when true its planning is gated until every earlier dependency level is fully implemented. See parentTask.plan_after_prior. Ignored on ordinary leaf tasks and subtasks.
